title: deadline slack before optimization

definition.title: deadline slack before optimization
definition.source_excerpt: A deterministic three-stage media pipeline model assigns explicit source-read, processing, and append boundaries before each presentation deadline. One middle segment receives a controlled delay at one stage at a time; binary search finds the last delay that does not miss a presentation deadline. Result. Measured safe slack is ~270 ms at read, ~138 ms at process, and ~37 ms at append. The method identifies append as the tightest stage; pushing append past that threshold produces a miss while baseline does not. Boundary. This validates the measurement method, not Demuxe's real scheduler. Production qualification requires real timestamps for read/demux/transform/append/presentation, queue depth, browser scheduling, and playback deadlines.
